description:
Self-hosted and scalable music streaming, designed for humans.

UniRhy is a self-hosted music streaming platform organized as a monorepo with separated backend, frontend, and website projects. It aims to provide deployable and extensible music library management, playback, and synchronization capabilities, with cross-platform clients for the web, macOS, Windows, Android and iOS.
Tip
macOS 安装包未签名，若提示应用已损坏，执行 xattr -cr /Applications/UniRhy.app 移除隔离属性即可
feat
- 私有化部署，无外部服务依赖
- 跨平台客户端：Web、macOS、Windows、Android、iOS，
- 同账号多设备播放同步，播放进度与队列跨会话持久化
- 插件扩展体系：统一的权限管控与 Host API，支持媒体导入、任务定义与配置持久化
- 曲库管理：扫描、整理、转码，支持文件系统与对象存储
- 官网双语首页与文档中心
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Coooolfan/UniRhy/commits/0.1.0
